    4 * c ^ 2 - 2 * c - 1 = 0 := by

  set c := cos θ

  have hs : s ≠ 0 := by
    rw [ne_eq, sin_eq_zero_iff, hθ]
    push_neg
    intro n hn
    replace hn : n * 5 = 1 := by field_simp [mul_comm _ π, mul_assoc] at hn; norm_cast at hn

                 _ = s * (4 * c ^ 2 - 1) := by linarith
